_about: FK2 progression (Progression.cs). Killing a zone boss unlocks its step for good (saved as gate id prog_step_<n> in the zones save). Joan's max health / max stamina / damage are multiplied by every unlocked step, and each step gives one perk: a multiplier on a stance-layer seam (blockCostMul: block stamina cost, blockChipMul: chip damage through a block, attackCostMul: swing stamina cost, postureTakenMul: posture taken, parryWindowMul: parry window, moveSpeedMul: move speed). All values are PLACEHOLDERS for Dom's balance call; 1.0 = no effect. enabled false or no file = off. Zone, spawn = the boss's spawn row, only used to credit a boss already killed in an older save (no toast).
